gettingStarted.title: Getting Started
gettingStarted.bgm: Choose BGM to load the music and set its offset.
gettingStarted.bpm: Choose BPM and tap the BPM change at the start of the chart. Tap it again to edit its BPM.
gettingStarted.bpmClick: Choose BPM and click the BPM change at the start of the chart. Click it again to edit its BPM.
gettingStarted.notes: Choose Note and tap the chart to add a note. To add a slide, choose Deselect, then Slide, and tap at its start and its end.
gettingStarted.notesClick: Choose Note and click the chart to add a note. To add a slide, choose Deselect, then Slide, and click at its start and its end.

touchscreen.longPress: Long-press an object to open the context menu.

touchscreen.gestures: Tap with two fingers to deselect. Tap with three fingers to start or stop playback.

mouse.contextMenu: Right-click an object to open the context menu, or right-drag to use Select.

mouse.zoom: Hold Ctrl and use the mouse wheel to zoom vertically, or Ctrl and Shift to zoom horizontally.

keyboard.title: Keyboard
keyboard.settings: View and change shortcuts in Settings › Keyboard Shortcuts.

selectTool.select: Where objects overlap, each tap selects the next one.
selectTool.selectClick: Where objects overlap, each click selects the next one.
selectTool.move: Drag a selected object to move the whole selection.
selectTool.resize: Drag the edge of a note, camera event or stage mask event to resize it. If all selected objects are the same type, they resize together.
selectTool.modifiers: Hold Ctrl (Cmd on macOS) to add objects to the selection or remove them. Hold Shift to select whole slides.
selectTool.selectMultiple: Drag a box from empty space to select the objects in it.

eraserTool.erase: Tap an object to erase it, or drag a box to erase everything in it.
eraserTool.eraseClick: Click an object to erase it, or drag a box to erase everything in it.
eraserTool.selection: Tap a selected object to erase the whole selection.
eraserTool.selectionClick: Click a selected object to erase the whole selection.

brushTool.properties: Choose Brush, then set the properties to apply.
brushTool.brush: Tap an object or drag a box to apply the brush. Tap a selected object to apply it to the whole selection.
brushTool.brushClick: Click an object or drag a box to apply the brush. Click a selected object to apply it to the whole selection.
brushTool.shift: Hold Shift to apply the brush to whole slides.

pasteTool.paste: Tap or drag to place the copied objects. Hold Shift to flip them horizontally.
pasteTool.pasteClick: Click or drag to place the copied objects. Hold Shift to flip them horizontally.

noteTool.presets: Choose Note again to show the default properties and switch between the presets, Note #1 to Note #4.
noteTool.quickEdit: When the Properties panel is shown, tap a selected note to set or cycle the current preset’s properties on all selected notes. For example, the default Note #2 preset turns Critical on or off.
noteTool.quickEditClick: When the Properties panel is shown, click a selected note to set or cycle the current preset’s properties on all selected notes. For example, the default Note #2 preset turns Critical on or off.

slideTool.connect: When notes of one slide are selected, tap empty space to add another note to that slide. Choose Deselect before starting a new slide.
slideTool.connectClick: When notes of one slide are selected, click empty space to add another note to that slide. Choose Deselect before starting a new slide.
slideTool.presets: Choose Slide again to show the default properties and switch between the presets, Slide #1 to Slide #5.
slideTool.quickEdit: As with Note, tap a selected note to set or cycle the current preset’s properties on all selected notes. For example, the default Slide #1 preset changes Connector Ease.
slideTool.quickEditClick: As with Note, click a selected note to set or cycle the current preset’s properties on all selected notes. For example, the default Slide #1 preset changes Connector Ease.
slideTool.splitCombine: Split Slide cuts the connection after each selected note. Combine into Slide joins the slides containing the selected notes.

generateSlideNotesTool.generate: Tap a note to fill its slide with attached notes, one on each empty division line.
generateSlideNotesTool.generateClick: Click a note to fill its slide with attached notes, one on each empty division line.
generateSlideNotesTool.generateMultiple: Drag a box over two or more notes of a slide to fill only the part between them. Tap a selected note to fill each slide in the selection. For a slide with only one selected note, this fills the whole slide.
generateSlideNotesTool.generateMultipleClick: Drag a box over two or more notes of a slide to fill only the part between them. Click a selected note to fill each slide in the selection. For a slide with only one selected note, this fills the whole slide.

adding.editClick: Click a selected object to show its properties.
adding.move: Drag an object to move only that object. To move several objects together, use Select.
adding.resize: Drag the edge of a note, camera event or stage mask event to resize it.
adding.modifiers: Hold Ctrl (Cmd on macOS) and tap to add an object to the selection or remove it. Hold Shift and tap a note to select its whole slide.
adding.modifiersClick: Hold Ctrl (Cmd on macOS) and click to add an object to the selection or remove it. Hold Shift and click a note to select its whole slide.

about.title: About
about.usageStatisticsNote: We use usage statistics to decide which features to improve. They include which tools you use, some editor settings, file types and sizes, and how long actions take. See the Privacy Notice for details.
about.usageStatisticsSignal: Off by default because this browser sends a Do Not Track or Global Privacy Control signal.
about.diagnosticsNote: Diagnostic info may include file and folder names. Check it before sharing.

descriptions.waveform: Shows the BGM’s loudness (Volume) or its frequencies (FFT) on the chart.
descriptions.zeroWidthNotes: Sets which notes can be made zero lanes wide.
descriptions.dimUnchangedObjects: Sets the default for Show Edits when you view Timeline steps.
descriptions.showOtherGroups: Shows objects in other groups, faded, while a group is focused.
descriptions.showOtherStages: Shows objects on other stages, faded, while a stage is focused.
descriptions.showOtherObjects: Shows objects of the types you have hidden, faded.
descriptions.nameContrast: Outlines group and stage names in black and brightens stage names.
descriptions.dragToPanY: Scrolls the chart up or down when you drag near its top or bottom edge.
descriptions.dragToPanX: Scrolls the chart sideways when you drag near its left or right edge.
descriptions.previewRenderScale: Scales the preview’s rendering resolution. Lower values reduce detail and rendering work.
descriptions.previewInWorker: Draws the preview in parallel with the rest of the editor. Turn this off if the preview looks wrong or does not appear.
descriptions.toolbarQuickSwitch: Lets you hold a toolbar button and release on a tool to choose it.
descriptions.playFollowPosition: Sets where Follow keeps the cursor during playback, from 0 at the bottom of the chart to 100 at the top.
descriptions.playPreviewDuration: Sets how long the BGM plays when you move the cursor or select an object.
descriptions.mouseSecondaryTool: Sets what right-click and right-drag do.

beatDisplay.intro: Sets how beat positions are numbered.

choices.beat: Shows a continuous count from 1 across the chart.
choices.measure: Shows the measure and the beat within it, and aligns snapping to measures.
choices.both: Shows the two formats together, and aligns snapping to measures.

descriptions.showGroupName: Shows group names beside notes and time scale changes outside the default group.
descriptions.showStageName: Shows stage names beside notes and stage events when Dynamic Stages is on.
descriptions.maxScrollX: Sets how far you can scroll left or right from the chart’s center. In Composed layout, you can scroll farther to reach notes and stages.

elevationEditorSideBySide.intro: Sets whether the Elevation Editor opens beside the chart or in place of it.

choices.auto: Opens it beside the chart when there is room.
choices.allow: Opens it beside the chart even when the chart gets narrow.
choices.disallow: Opens it in place of the chart.

descriptions.elevationConnectorArrows: Shows arrows from each connector’s start to its end on selected or hovered slides, where there is room between the notes.

groupsStagesSideBySide.intro: Sets when Groups and Stages are shown side by side below Preview. This applies when all three are shown in the left panels or all in the right panels.

choices.auto: Puts them side by side when the panels are wide.
choices.enabled: Puts them side by side whenever both fit.

descriptions.confirmCloseUnsavedFile: Asks before the page closes while changes are not saved to a project file, even when they are stored in this browser. When closing would lose edits, the editor always asks.
descriptions.previewNoteSpeed: Higher values make notes approach faster in the preview.
descriptions.previewShowHitboxes: Shows the areas used to judge notes and slides, shortly before notes are hit and while slides are active.
descriptions.previewShowEffects: Shows particles and glows when notes are hit and while slides are held in the preview.
descriptions.previewAntialias: Smooths jagged edges in the preview.
descriptions.previewTransportPosition: Places the playback controls below the preview or over its lower edge. With Auto, they go below when the preview fits without shrinking, and over it otherwise.
descriptions.previewControls: Sets whether the preview settings are expanded or collapsed to a button while playback is stopped. With Auto, they start expanded when you use a mouse and they fit in the preview panel.
descriptions.playStartPosition: Sets where Play starts. With View, it starts at the bottom of the visible chart, or at Follow Position when Follow is on.
descriptions.playFollow: Scrolls the chart during playback to keep the cursor at Follow Position.
descriptions.touchQuickScrollWidth: Sets the width of the zone at the chart’s right edge where you can scroll with one finger. A value of 0 turns it off.
descriptions.touchQuickScrollShow: Shades the zone at the chart’s right edge where you can scroll with one finger.
descriptions.touchScrollInertia: Lets the chart keep scrolling and slow down gradually after a two-finger pan or a drag in the quick scroll zone.
